context.transcript:
I'm pleased to inform you today about a new employee benefit.
The management team knows that many of you have had problems commuting to work by train, so our company president has agreed to provide a free shuttle service to and from the train station for all employees.
All you need to do is show the driver your employee ID card each time you board.
Interested employees should fill out the survey that was sent to you by e-mail and send out the email to your employee.
That way we'll know how many buses we'll need.
context.transcript_translation:
今天很高兴地通知大家一项新的员工福利。
管理团队知道你们很多人通过火车通勤上班有困难，所以公司总裁同意为所有员工提供免费的往返火车站班车服务。
你只需要每次上车时向司机出示你的员工ID卡即可。
感兴趣的员工应该填写发送给你的调查问卷，并将邮件转发给你员工。
这样我们就能知道需要多少辆巴士了。
